match: Thing.label is string and this row gives it text holding U+0000
why: Measured from the reference on 1 November 2026: PostgreSQL's driver refused this save, and ClickHouse stored the text with its U+0000. A copy of such a group from ClickHouse to PostgreSQL stopped at the chunk holding it, with the driver's error, after 2 of 5 rows. Refused before either engine.
